name: SIGINT
standfirst: Security research and practitioner news, scored for novelty and actionability.
colophon: sigint.wtf — the correct response to most of these CVEs. Scored by machine against a hand-written rubric; ranking is opinion, not fact.

items.title: ToFu: Exploiting and Fuzzing the LLM-Orchestrator-Tool Trust Boundary
items.authors: Md Nazmul Islam Ananto et al.
items.dek: Automated fuzzing of LLM-orchestrator-tool boundaries found 343 tools across 118 MCP servers fail to enforce documented input semantics.
items.unproven: Focus on MCP servers; behavior of tools behind other orchestration layers or in production agent deployments not addressed.

items.title: APEX-Harm: Evaluating Agent Safety in Shared Professional Workspaces
items.dek: APEX-Harm benchmark of 180 agent tasks shows task-specific script injection succeeds 81–84% of the time even against frontier models.
items.unproven: Benchmark tasks are synthetic; attacks designed by researchers rather than adversaries in the wild; generalization to agent workflows outside finance and legal domains unclear.

items.title: Understanding and Mitigating Cross-Session Attacks via Persistent Artifacts in Agent Skill Composition
items.dek: AI agent skills can leak data and inject code across sessions via persistent artifacts; 270-case benchmark exposes instruction propagation, boundary violations, and evidence poisoning.
items.unproven: Evaluation on benchmark scenarios; generalization to production agent frameworks and real-world deployment patterns not demonstrated.

items.title: AI Models Can Provably Hide Arbitrary Capabilities
items.dek: Backdoors with encrypted neural networks can hide arbitrary computations in model weights and resist elicitation attempts even under full access.
items.unproven: Threat model assumes adversary cannot obtain the secret trigger; scalability to production-scale models and defenses against trigger discovery through alternative means remain untested.

items.title: Post-Quantum Session Establishment for Matter over Thread: Message Size, Transport, and Protocol Options
items.dek: Matter's CASE handshake cannot fit post-quantum ML-KEM/ML-DSA in Thread's 1178-byte limit; multi-hop fragmentation causes 1.8–2.6× delays and 33% handshake failure.
items.unproven: Evaluation on Thread over IPv6; applicability to Matter deployments in financial services unclear; no specification change or deployment guidance.

items.title: The Limits of Query Monitoring against Distributed Model Extraction
items.dek: Distributed model extraction campaigns are detectable only if more distinctive than the most distinctive benign user group in the same week.
items.unproven: One model family (chat); campaign padding strategies beyond natural text not explored; does not cover extraction defenses the reader could implement.

items.title: Telegram Desktop vulnerability allowed any user's file to be stolen
items.dek: Telegram Desktop path traversal allowed file theft; vulnerability now patched.
items.unproven: whether the flaw affected production deployments at scale or only under specific user conditions

items.title: A Systematic Study of Security Enforcement at Android Inter-Component Boundaries
items.dek: Systematic audit of Android inter-component security found 97 enforcement gaps across 30 Google and AOSP packages.
items.unproven: Study covers Android 17 on curated packages; does not establish whether gaps are exploitable in realistic threat models or present in third-party applications.

items.title: EviRepair: Evidence-Driven Agents for Reliable Vulnerability Repair
items.dek: Multi-agent framework for automated vulnerability repair improves resolution rates by 16–40% through evidence verification.
items.unproven: Improvements measured on benchmark sets; no evidence that evidence review reduces false-positive repairs or is necessary in production SDLC tooling.

items.title: Quantization-Tolerant Gradient Auditing for Active Inference-Attack Detection in Federated Learning
items.dek: Server-side checksum challenge detects active gradient attacks in federated learning with zero false positives on controlled tests.
items.unproven: Evaluation limited to up to 40% malicious ratio with 50 clients; robustness against adaptive attackers that learn the checksum scheme untested; assumes trusted server.

items.title: CAPE - Context-Aware Prioritization Engine for Vulnerability Scoring and Management
items.dek: CAPE enriches CVE reports with deployment-specific reachability, centrality, and exploitability analysis to prioritize patching across 30 agentic applications.
items.unproven: Commercial tool with methodology section; evaluation limited to open-source agentic applications; generalization to financial services SDLC unclear.

items.title: Space Over Statistic, Retraining Over Ranking: Auditing Training Labels Under Label-Only Backdoors
items.dek: Label-only backdoor defenses fail in the poisoned feature space but recover when retraining on clean or frozen features; feature space choice, not test choice, decides.
items.unproven: Limited to image classification; poisoning defense evaluation does not connect to reader's SAST/DAST/SCA tooling or secure-SDLC practices.

items.title: Provably Subexponential Algorithms for Bounded-Error LWE with Few Samples
items.dek: Subexponential algorithm solves bounded-error LWE with fewer samples and smaller secrets; Wagner/BKW variant achieves 2^(O(n/ln ln n)) time complexity.
items.unproven: Theoretical result; no implementation or concrete runtime comparison; relevance to reader's post-quantum migration planning is abstract and long-term.

items.title: AgentValve: Sybil-Resilient Payment Authorization for Permissionless AI Markets
items.dek: Protocol for Sybil-resilient payment authorization in permissionless AI markets using trust networks and smart contracts.
items.unproven: applicability to the reader's financial services SDLC; whether AI agent procurement through permissionless markets is a deployment pattern in scope.

items.title: Scandinavia's first farmers slaughtered hunter-gatherer population, DNA suggests
items.dek: Genetic evidence shows early Scandinavian farmers displaced hunter-gatherers.
items.unproven: unrelated to application security, secure SDLC, or any engineering discipline the reader owns

items.title: Valen's Memory Safety: A New Kind of Borrow Checking
items.dek: Valen proposes an alternative memory-safety model using borrow checking without traditional lifetime syntax.
items.unproven: language research with no evidence of adoption in production systems or impact on SAST/DAST tooling the reader operates

items.title: An entangling Hubbard quasiparticle collider on a digital quantum processor
items.dek: Quasiparticle scattering in Fermi-Hubbard model realized on IBM quantum processor; transmission probability matches Bethe ansatz.
items.unproven: entirely outside reader's domain; quantum physics research with no application to application security, SDLC, or enterprise systems.

items.title: A Warped Born Rule Turns an Observer into a Maxwell's Demon
items.dek: Warped Born rule in quantum mechanics drives many-body systems to frozen or hyperuniform configurations via repeated measurement.
items.unproven: entirely outside reader's domain; theoretical quantum mechanics with no bearing on security engineering or enterprise systems.

items.title: Decision-Focused Learning for Cyber-Physical Risk-Aware Power Grid Operations
items.dek: Optimization-learning framework jointly minimizes detection error and power grid operational costs in intrusion detection.
items.unproven: Evaluation on two datasets only; no comparison to operational baselines or deployment in live control systems; cost-model generalization unclear.

items.title: Secrets in Preamble: Practical and Robust PHY Information Hiding for Wi-Fi
items.dek: Neural-network-based PHY information hiding embeds secrets in Wi-Fi legacy training fields with robustness to temporal shifts.
items.unproven: Prototype evaluated in controlled indoor and outdoor settings; security against active adversaries and real-world deployment conditions not established; outside application security remit.

items.title: ECGWmark: Deep Watermarking for Electrocardiogram Signals
items.dek: Deep watermarking preserves ECG diagnostic quality while embedding patient metadata with robustness to temporal desynchronization.
items.unproven: Evaluation on MIT-BIH database only; clinical validation and security against removal attacks not addressed; outside application security remit.

items.title: LETHE: Defending against Unauthorized Image-to-Video Generation via Value Diversity Collapse
items.dek: Adversarial perturbation method disrupts image-to-video generation by collapsing value diversity in reference image encoding.
items.unproven: Evaluated on limited I2V model architectures; robustness to adaptive attacks and transferability to future model variants not tested; outside SDLC and agent-integration scope.

items.title: Understanding Verification Vulnerabilities in Cross-chain Bridges: An Empirical Study
items.dek: Analysis of 588 audits identifies 11 cross-chain bridge verification vulnerability patterns; taxonomy organizes 830 instances into 5 categories.
items.unproven: Outside reader's remit; blockchain security is not part of application security engineering practice in traditional financial services.

items.title: Safety Graph: When Safety Responses Become Attack Surfaces in Cyber-Physical Systems
items.dek: Safety responses in industrial control systems can become attack surfaces for lateral movement; Safety Graph framework unifies attack, fault, and event trees.
items.unproven: Outside reader's remit; industrial control systems security is distinct from application security in financial services.

items.title: Satya Nadella says we should assume all AI models are 'compromised'
items.dek: Microsoft executive urges assuming AI models are compromised; offers no mechanism or detection method.
items.unproven: no technical definition of 'compromised' or guidance applicable to SDLC model vetting

noise.title: `123456' password used in Danish CPR data breach
noise.dek: Danish breach exposed millions; attackers used trivial password on admin account.

noise.title: Germany transforms former coal mines into Europe's largest lake landscape
noise.dek: Germany converts mines to lakes; environmental infrastructure project unrelated to security.

noise.title: Scam American companies are using to manipulate ingredient lists
noise.dek: Social media thread on ingredient list manipulation; consumer fraud, not software security.
